fit.intro: Enter your measurements and we'll suggest a size.
fit.above: Your measurements are above our largest size. [size] may feel tight.
fit.below: Your measurements are below our smallest size. [size] may feel loose.
fit.privacy: Your measurements stay on this device.

sizemate.editor_no_chart: Sizemate: no size chart is assigned to this product. Assign one in the Sizemate app, or check that the chart is active.

how.bust: Measure around the fullest part of your bust, keeping the tape level under your arms.
how.chest: Measure around the fullest part of your chest, just under your armpits, keeping the tape level.
how.underbust: Measure snugly around your ribcage, directly under your bust.
how.waist: Measure around your natural waistline, the narrowest part of your torso, usually just above the belly button.
how.hips: Stand with your feet together and measure around the fullest part of your hips.
how.neck: Measure around the base of your neck, leaving room for one finger under the tape.
how.shoulder: Measure across your back from the edge of one shoulder to the other.
how.arm: With your arm relaxed, measure from the shoulder seam down to your wrist bone.
how.inseam: Measure from the top of your inner thigh down to your ankle.
how.thigh: Measure around the fullest part of your thigh.
how.height: Stand straight against a wall without shoes and measure from the floor to the top of your head.
how.foot_length: Stand on paper with your heel against a wall and measure from the wall to the tip of your longest toe.
how.foot_width: Measure across the widest part of your foot.
how.head: Measure around your head just above the eyebrows and ears.
how.hand: Measure around your palm at the widest point, excluding the thumb.
how.pet_neck: Measure around the base of your pet's neck where the collar sits.
how.pet_chest: Measure around the widest part of your pet's ribcage, just behind the front legs.
how.pet_back: Measure from the base of the neck to the base of the tail.
how.garment_chest: Lay the garment flat and measure straight across, just below the armholes.
how.garment_waist: Lay the garment flat and measure straight across the waistband.
how.garment_length: Lay the garment flat and measure from the highest point of the shoulder to the bottom hem.
how.sleeve: Measure from the shoulder seam to the end of the sleeve.
